mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.5%, signaling aggressive monetary tightening, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 3.2% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs), a tightening labor market with rising wages boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.05 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month consecutive decline in INDPRO, signaling supply chain disruptions, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 45% of instances with 2-month INDPRO declines, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding $700k, indicating strong housing market demand, correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate broader economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with RSAFS growth > $700k, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the level of FEDFUNDS, as a proxy for the overall monetary policy stance, inversely correlates with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, with higher rates leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window, or SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances with FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between UNRATE (below 3.5%) and PAYEMS (above 150k new jobs) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during mid-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances during mid-cycle expansions, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.05 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month average INDPRO above 105, indicating robust industrial production, correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but this relationship inverts during late-cycle contractions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with 3-month INDPRO average > 105 outside of late-cycle contractions, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.
